<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
    Commit: 98ef2b9
    Updated: 2026-01-16 16:00:00 AEDT (UTC+10)
    Changes: Added Customer PO to MO tooltips, View by WO#/BOM# dropdown for calendar/capacity tiles

    Commit: (pending)
    Updated: 2026-03-09
    Changes:
      - Right-click on WO tile: two date pickers (start + end) to set WO dates
      - saveWODates: enforce start time < finish time; if same day conflict reset to 06:00–18:00
      - Close context menu on Escape or click-outside

    v4 — UX redesign (plan: vivid-watching-wadler.md)
      - 56px stacked header borrowed from purchaseordersummary.htm
      - Flat .hdr-btn vocabulary replaces 3 competing button styles
      - Applied-filter chip strip below header
      - Capacity toolbar flattened; pending-changes bar inline (no fixed bottom)
      - Heatmap + weekly capacity grid use navy table header + denser rows
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Manufacturing Capacity Planning (beta)</title>

    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

    <!-- D3.js -->
    <script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Moment.js -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Google Fonts -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
        }

        /* Custom Brand Colors */
        :root {
            --color-primary: #2d9cdb;
            --color-primary-dark: #1e7bb4;
            --color-sidebar: #06162d;
            --color-sidebar-hover: #0a1f3d;
            /* v4 redesign tokens — keep size/colour decisions in one place so
               future tweaks don't have to chase Tailwind utility classes. */
            --header-h: 56px;
            --header-dark: #1e3a5f;   /* PO-summary table-header navy */
            --border-default: #e2e8f0;
            --border-strong:  #cbd5e1;
            --hover-bg: #f8fafc;
            --tint-bg:  #eff6ff;
            --muted:    #475569;
            --muted-2:  #64748b;
        }

        /* ── v4 primitive: .hdr-btn (ported from purchaseordersummary.htm) ──
           Single button vocabulary across the whole planner. Replaces the
           rounded-xl icon-only header buttons, the bg-slate-100 toolbar
           buttons, and the bright indigo Auto-Schedule pill. State variants:
             .hdr-btn         — neutral white pill
             .hdr-btn:hover   — light slate wash
             .hdr-btn.active  — soft blue tint (used for selected view, "on"
                                toggles like Show Arrows, current week, etc.)
             .hdr-btn.primary — accent fill (Save All; rare, use sparingly)
             .hdr-btn-icon    — square icon-only variant for refresh/settings */
        .hdr-btn {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
            padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: white; color: var(--muted);
            cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .hdr-btn:hover   { background: var(--hover-bg); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
        .hdr-btn.active  { background: var(--tint-bg); border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #2563eb; }
        .hdr-btn:disabled,
        .hdr-btn[disabled] { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .hdr-btn svg     { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .hdr-btn-icon    { padding: 7px; border-radius: 8px; }
        .hdr-btn.primary {
            background: var(--color-primary); border-color: var(--color-primary-dark);
            color: white;
        }
        .hdr-btn.primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .hdr-btn.danger  {
            background: white; border-color: #fecaca; color: #b91c1c;
        }
        .hdr-btn.danger:hover { background: #fef2f2; }

        /* Stitched button group — single border wraps multiple .hdr-btn,
           segments share inner separators. Used for 1W/2W/1M/3M, axis
           granularity, zoom, diff mode, save/discard pair. */
        .btn-group {
            display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
            border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .btn-group .hdr-btn {
            border: none; border-radius: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default);
        }
        .btn-group .hdr-btn:last-child { border-right: none; }
        .btn-group .hdr-btn.active     { background: var(--tint-bg); color: #2563eb; }

        /* Visual separator between button clusters in a toolbar. */
        .toolbar-sep {
            width: 1px; height: 22px; background: var(--border-default); margin: 0 4px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* Clickable row identifier (WO 1234, MO 567 etc.). */
        .row-link  { color: var(--color-primary); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
        .row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--color-primary-dark); }

        /* ── Applied-filter chip strip ──
           Sits below the global header. Each active filter renders as a
           chip with an × to remove. "+ Add filter" is itself a chip-style
           hdr-btn that opens the existing #filtersPanel popover. */
        #filterChipStrip {
            background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
            padding: 6px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap; flex-shrink: 0; min-height: 36px;
        }
        .filter-chip {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px 4px 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
            background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4;
            border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
        }
        .filter-chip-label {
            color: #1e3a8a; opacity: 0.6; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 2px;
        }
        .filter-chip-x {
            cursor: pointer; padding: 0 5px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
            color: #3b82f6; border-radius: 999px; line-height: 1;
        }
        .filter-chip-x:hover { background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e3a8a; }
        .filter-chip-add {
            font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px;
            border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); background: white;
            color: var(--muted-2); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
        }
        .filter-chip-add:hover { background: var(--hover-bg); color: var(--muted); }
        .filter-chip-empty {
            font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic;
        }

        /* Inline status line (replaces the kpi-tile row in the header). */
        .status-line {
            font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-2); line-height: 1.3;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .status-line .sep { color: #cbd5e1; }
        .status-line .alert {
            color: #b45309; cursor: help; font-weight: 600;
        }
        .status-line .alert.over { color: #b91c1c; }

        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 4px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #94a3b8; }

        /* Override Tailwind indigo with custom blue */
        .bg-indigo-600 { background-color: var(--color-primary) !important; }
        .bg-indigo-50 { background-color: rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.1) !important; }
        .text-indigo-600 { color: var(--color-primary) !important; }
        .text-indigo-700 { color: var(--color-primary-dark) !important; }
        .border-indigo-200 { border-color: rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.3) !important; }
        .hover\:text-indigo-600:hover { color: var(--color-primary) !important; }
        .hover\:bg-indigo-50:hover { background-color: rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.1) !important; }
        .focus\:ring-indigo-100:focus { --tw-ring-color: rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.2) !important; }
        .shadow-indigo-900\/20 { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.2) !important; }

        /* Sidebar colors */
        .bg-slate-900 { background-color: var(--color-sidebar) !important; }
        .bg-slate-800 { background-color: var(--color-sidebar-hover) !important; }

        /* Gantt Chart Styles */
        .wo-bar {
            cursor: move;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        }
        .wo-bar:hover { opacity: 0.9; }
        .wo-bar.dragging { opacity: 0.6; }

        .dependency-arrow { pointer-events: none; }
        .dependency-arrow.conflict { stroke: #ef4444; }

        /* Capacity Table */
        .capacity-table-wrapper {
            cursor: grab;
            user-select: none;
        }
        .capacity-table-wrapper:active { cursor: grabbing; }

        .capacity-wo-bar {
            cursor: move;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        .capacity-wo-bar:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        /* Toast Container */
        .toast-container {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 1rem;
            right: 1rem;
            z-index: 9999;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .toast {
            min-width: 300px;
            padding: 1rem;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { transform: translateX(400px); opacity: 0; }
            to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
        }

        .toast.success { border-color: #10b981; }
        .toast.error { border-color: #ef4444; }
        .toast.info { border-color: #6366f1; }

        /* Modal/Offcanvas */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            z-index: 9998;
            display: none;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        .modal-overlay.show { display: block; }

        .offcanvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            right: -500px;
            width: 500px;
            height: 100%;
            background: white;
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: right 0.3s ease-out;
            box-shadow: -10px 0 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }

        .offcanvas.show { right: 0; }

        /* Loading Spinner */
        .spinner {
            border: 3px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-top-color: #6366f1;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        /* Sidebar transition */
        .sidebar-collapsed { width: 5rem; }
        .sidebar-expanded { width: 16rem; }

        /* Custom Tooltips */
        .wo-tooltip {
            position: absolute;
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
            color: white;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 10000;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
            max-width: 300px;
            white-space: pre-line;
        }
        .wo-tooltip.show { opacity: 1; }
        .wo-tooltip-label {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #94a3b8;
            margin-right: 0.5rem;
        }
        .wo-tooltip-value {
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        /* Gantt Context Menu */
        .gantt-context-menu {
            position: fixed;
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0 4px 10px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            padding: 1rem;
            z-index: 10002;
            min-width: 230px;
            display: none;
        }
        .gantt-context-menu.show { display: block; }
        .gantt-context-menu input[type="date"],
        .gantt-context-menu select {
            width: 100%;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
            border-radius: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem;
            font-size: 0.8125rem;
            color: #334155;
            outline: none;
            background: white;
        }
        .gantt-context-menu input[type="date"]:focus,
        .gantt-context-menu select:focus {
            border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,0.15);
        }

        /* ── Filters panel (toggled by header Filters button) ── */
        #filtersPanel { background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 10px 20px; display: none; flex-shrink: 0; }
        #filtersPanel.open { display: block; }
        #filtersPanel select, #filtersPanel input[type=text], #filtersPanel input[type=date] {
            padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px; color: #374151; background: #f9fafb; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        #filtersPanel input[type=date] { background: white; }

        /* ── Settings panel — same layout shell as filters ── */
        #settingsPanel { background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 10px 20px; display: none; flex-shrink: 0; }
        #settingsPanel.open { display: block; }
        .settings-group-title {
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        .settings-toggle {
            display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
            background: white; cursor: pointer; min-width: 200px; max-width: 280px;
        }
        .settings-toggle:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc; }
        .settings-toggle input[type=checkbox] {
            margin-top: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; accent-color: #2d9cdb;
        }
        .settings-toggle .lbl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; line-height: 1.3; }
        .settings-toggle .hint { font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 1px; }
        .settings-toggle.locked { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; background: #f8fafc; }
        .settings-toggle.locked input[type=checkbox] { pointer-events: none; }
        .settings-field { min-width: 180px; }
        .settings-field select {
            width: 100%; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px; color: #374151; background: #f9fafb; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }

        /* Sticky date header inside gantt scroll wrapper — solid background
           and high z-index so the SVG bars + the left labels overlay (which
           uses z-index 100) never bleed through. */
        #ganttWrapper { position: relative; }
        #ganttDateHeader {
            position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 200;
            background: white; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #e2e8f0;
        }
        /* Left labels overlay must sit below the date header so the top-left
           corner doesn't cover the dates. The renderer also positions the
           overlay with top:0; we leave that alone (the overlay is shorter
           than the chart) — the date header simply wins on z-index. */

        /* ── Debug console (Sales_Dashboard_DragDrop pattern: fixed bottom,
              dark log surface, resize handle, Copy button) ── */
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug {
            position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 9000;
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
            background: transparent; box-shadow: none; border: 0;
        }
        #debugResizeHandle {
            height: 5px; background: transparent; cursor: ns-resize;
            border-top: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-shell {
            background: white; box-shadow: 0 -4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-toggle {
            width: 100%; padding: 8px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between; background: none; border: none;
            cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-toggle:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug #debugContent {
            border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: white;
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-diag-bar {
            background: #1e293b; padding: 6px 14px;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-diag-bar .debug-action {
            font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; background: none; border: none;
            cursor: pointer; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
        }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug .debug-diag-bar .debug-action:hover { color: white; }
        #debugConsoleContainer.bottom-debug #debugLog {
            background: #0f172a; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 10px 14px;
            font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px;
            height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; max-height: none;
        }

        /* ── Multi-select (ported from Part/PartActivity.htm) ── */
        .ms-container { position: relative; }
        .ms-trigger {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px;
            background: white; height: 30px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
        }
        .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: #9ca3af; }
        .ms-tag {
            background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
        .ms-placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }
        .ms-dropdown {
            position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0; right: 0; min-width: 220px;
            background: white; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 280px;
        }
        .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
        .ms-search input {
            width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        .ms-actions { padding: 3px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
        .ms-actions span { color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; }
        .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
        .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
        .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
        .ms-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
        .ms-empty { padding: 12px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

        /* ── Group-by toggle (capacity view) ── */
        .groupby-btn {
            padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: white; color: #64748b; cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
        }
        .groupby-btn:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc; }
        .groupby-btn.active { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #2563eb; }

        /* ── Sticky date header (inside ganttWrapper) ──
           Note: the canonical #ganttDateHeader rule lives earlier in this
           stylesheet (z-index: 200, white background, sticky top:0). Only
           non-conflicting properties (height + bottom border) are set here
           so the row labels overlay never wins the stacking battle. */
        #ganttDateHeader {
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; height: 48px; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gantt-tick {
            position: absolute; top: 0; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; color: #475569;
            border-right: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
        }
        .gantt-tick.weekend { background: #fffbeb; }
        .gantt-tick.today { background: #fef2f2; }
        .gantt-tick-major { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
        .gantt-tick-minor { font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; }

        /* ── Pagination bar ── */
        #paginationBar {
            position: sticky; bottom: 0; padding: 6px 10px; background: white;
            border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: #475569; z-index: 5;
        }
        #paginationBar button {
            margin: 0 4px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            background: white; color: #2563eb; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer;
        }
        #paginationBar button:hover { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; }
        #paginationBar.hidden { display: none; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-50">
    <!-- Toast Container -->
    <div class="toast-container"></div>

    <!-- WO Context Menu -->
    <div id="woContextMenu" class="gantt-context-menu">
        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
            </svg>
            <span id="woContextMenuTitle">Set WO Dates</span>
        </div>
        <div class="space-y-3 mb-4">
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1">Start Date</label>
                <input type="date" id="woContextMenuStart">
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1">End Date</label>
                <input type="date" id="woContextMenuEnd">
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1">Category</label>
                <select id="woContextMenuCategory">
                    <!-- Populated dynamically from capacitySettings.categories -->
                </select>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="applyWOContextMenu()" class="flex-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors">Apply</button>
            <button onclick="hideAllContextMenus()" class="flex-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors">Cancel</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Tooltip Container -->
    <div id="woTooltip" class="wo-tooltip"></div>

    <!-- Modal Overlay -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay"></div>

    <!-- (Settings offcanvas removed — replaced by inline #settingsPanel

                    <p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">Manufacturing Capacity Planning (beta) provides three interactive views for visualizing and managing work order schedules:</p>
                    <ul class="text-sm text-slate-600 space-y-2 ml-4">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>MO Gantt View:</strong> Groups work orders by Manufacturing Order</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Category View:</strong> Groups work orders by manufacturing category (swim lanes)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Capacity Planning:</strong> Weekly calendar view with drag-and-drop scheduling and capacity tracking</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">MO Gantt & Category Views</h3>
                    <ul class="text-sm text-slate-600 space-y-2 ml-4">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Drag WO:</strong> Click and drag work order bars to reschedule (auto-scrolls to updated WO)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Resize WO:</strong> Drag left/right edge to adjust start/finish dates</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Right-click WO:</strong> Set WO start and end dates via date pickers</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Navigate:</strong> Scroll or drag the timeline, use prev/next week buttons</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Zoom:</strong> Use zoom buttons (persists across sessions)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>

                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Undo/Redo:</strong> Use toolbar buttons (50-step history)</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Capacity Planning View</h3>
                    <ul class="text-sm text-slate-600 space-y-2 ml-4">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Weekly View:</strong> Drag WOs horizontally (change dates) or vertically (change categories)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Monthly Calendar:</strong> Drag WOs to reschedule across days, navigate with month buttons or Today</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Category Sorting:</strong> Categories are sorted alphabetically by name</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Navigate:</strong> Use prev/next week buttons or Today button to jump to current week</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Capacity Settings:</strong> Click gear icon to set daily labor hours per category (auto-saves)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Color Coding:</strong> Green = under capacity, Orange = at capacity, Red = over capacity</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Search & Filter</h3>
                    <ul class="text-sm text-slate-600 space-y-2 ml-4">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Global Search:</strong> Searches WO numbers, MO numbers, part numbers, categories, and descriptions</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>MO Filter:</strong> Filter by specific Manufacturing Order (MO view only)</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Works Across Views:</strong> Search results apply to all views (gantt and capacity)</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Settings & Preferences</h3>
                    <ul class="text-sm text-slate-600 space-y-2 ml-4">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Auto-Save:</strong> All settings automatically save to database and persist across sessions</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Same-Day Starts:</strong> Allow/prevent multiple WOs in same MO from starting on same day</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Show Arrows:</strong> Toggle dependency arrows between WOs in same MO</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="text-indigo-600 mt-1">•</span>
                            <span><strong>Persisted Settings:</strong> Zoom level, collapsed MOs, calendar state, capacity limits</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>

            </div>

    <!-- Main Layout -->
    <div class="h-screen flex overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Main Content -->
        <main class="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 h-screen overflow-hidden bg-slate-50">
            <!-- Header — 56px compact, ported from PurchaseOrder/purchaseordersummary.htm.

                 updateKPIs). -->
            <header class="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-5 flex items-center justify-between flex-shrink-0 z-20 shadow-sm" style="height: var(--header-h);">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">

                            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9 19v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2zm0 0V9a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v10m-6 0a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v14a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2z"></path>

                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Capacity

                    </div>
                    <div class="min-w-0">

                        <!-- KPI summary rendered inline; populated by updateKPIs(). -->
                        <div id="statusLine" class="status-line">Loading…</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                    <button id="filtersToggleBtn" onclick="toggleFilters()" class="hdr-btn" title="Show/hide filters">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h16a1 1 0 011 1v2.586a1 1 0 01-.293.707l-6.414 6.414a1 1 0 00-.293.707V17l-4 4v-6.586a1 1 0 00-.293-.707L3.293 7.293A1 1 0 013 6.586V4z"/>
                        </svg>
                        Filters
                    </button>
                    <button id="settingsToggleBtn" onclick="toggleSettings()" class="hdr-btn" title="Show/hide settings">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path>

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253"></path>

            <!-- Applied-filter chip strip — sits below the header. Each active

                    </button>

            <!-- Filters Panel (hidden by default; toggled by Filters button) -->
            <div id="filtersPanel">

                                <span class="ms-placeholder" id="lgPlaceholder">All location groups</span>

                                <span class="ms-placeholder" id="catPlaceholder">All categories</span>

                                <div class="ms-actions"><span id="catAll">Select All</span><span id="catClear">Clear All</span></div>
                                <div class="ms-list" id="catList"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <!-- MO # -->
                    <div style="min-width:160px; max-width:240px;">
                        <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">MO #</div>

                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

            <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-4 lg:p-6">

                     radius/shadow, no in-card title (#viewTitle in the header
                     already names the view). Toolbar is one flat row of
                     .hdr-btn + .btn-group + .toolbar-sep. -->

<script>
// ============================================
// DEBUG MODE CONFIGURATION
// ============================================
// Check if debug mode should be enabled via Fishbowl property
// Default to 'false' if property cannot be read or doesn't exist
const BI_SHOW_DEBUG_PROP = (typeof getProperty === 'function' ? getProperty('BI_SHOW_DEBUG', 'false') : null) || 'false';
const DEBUG_MODE = BI_SHOW_DEBUG_PROP === 'true' || BI_SHOW_DEBUG_PROP === true;

// Get date format from Fishbowl settings
const FB_DATE_FORMAT = typeof getProperty === 'function' ? getProperty('DateFormatShort', 'MM/dd/yyyy') : 'MM/dd/yyyy';
// Convert Java SimpleDateFormat to moment.js format (dd -> DD, yyyy -> YYYY)
const MOMENT_DATE_FORMAT = FB_DATE_FORMAT
    .replace(/yyyy/g, 'YYYY')
    .replace(/yy/g, 'YY')
    .replace(/dd/g, 'DD');

// ============================================
// GLOBAL VARIABLES
// ============================================
let allWorkOrders = [];
let filteredWorkOrders = [];
let manufacturingOrders = [];
let categories = [];
let stagingDependencies = [];
let conflicts = new Set();

let viewMode = 'mo'; // 'mo', 'category', 'capacity'
let currentCapacityWeek = null;
let capacitySettings = { categories: [] };
let collapsedMOs = new Set(); // Track which MOs are collapsed in MO view

// Undo/Redo
let undoStack = [];
let redoStack = [];
const MAX_UNDO_STACK = 50;

// D3 Gantt Settings
let ganttScale = 80; // pixels per day

// ============================================
// SETTINGS PERSISTENCE (Sales Dashboard pattern)
// Per-user state goes to saveSettings/loadSettings under SETTINGS_KEY.
// Admin master defaults + userEditing toggle go to saveReportData/
// loadReportData (single blob, visible to all users).
// ============================================
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'cdx.bi.wo-capacity-planner';
let _isAdmin = false;
let _userEditingAllowed = true;
let _globalData = {};

function _biSave(data) {
    if (typeof saveSettings !== 'function') return;
    try { saveSettings(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(data)); }
    catch (e) { debugLog('warn', 'saveSettings failed:', e); }
}
function _biLoad() {
    if (typeof loadSettings !== 'function') return null;
    try {
        const r = loadSettings(SETTINGS_KEY);
        return r ? JSON.parse(r) : null;
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('warn', 'loadSettings parse failed:', e);
        return null;
    }
}
function _loadGlobalData() {
    if (typeof loadReportData !== 'function') return;
    try {
        const rd = loadReportData();
        if (rd) _globalData = JSON.parse(rd);
        _userEditingAllowed = _globalData.userEditing !== false;
    } catch (e) { /* no global data yet */ }
}
function _saveGlobalData() {
    if (typeof saveReportData !== 'function') return;
    try { saveReportData(JSON.stringify(_globalData)); }
    catch (e) { debugLog('warn', 'saveReportData failed:', e); }
}

// Detect whether the current user is the BI admin. Two ways:
//   1. system property BI_ADMIN_USER_ID matches sysuser.id (default 1)
//   2. system property BI_ADMIN_USER matches userName
function _detectAdmin() {
    try {
        if (typeof getUser !== 'function') return false;
        const u = JSON.parse(getUser() || '{}');
        const adminId = (typeof getProperty === 'function')
            ? getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER_ID', '1') : '1';
        const adminUser = (typeof getProperty === 'function')
            ? getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER', '') : '';
        if (u.id != null && String(u.id) === String(adminId)) return true;
        if (adminUser && u.userName && u.userName === adminUser) return true;
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return false;
}

// Migrate legacy base64-in-fake-part settings to the new store on first
// load. Returns the legacy settings object (or null if not present).
function _readLegacySettings() {
    if (typeof runQuery !== 'function') return null;
    try {
        const rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
            "SELECT details FROM part WHERE num = '_settingsCapacityPlanner' LIMIT 1"
        ));
        if (rows && rows.length && rows[0].details) {
            return JSON.parse(atob(rows[0].details));
        }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
}

// Persist current filter state into the saved payload.
function _persistFilterState() {
    const saved = _biLoad() || {};
    saved.filterState = {
        statuses:       [..._selStatus],
        locationGroups: [..._selLG],
        categories:     [..._selCat],
        moNums:         [..._selMO],
        partNums:       [..._selPart],
        woNums:         [..._selWO]
    };
    _biSave(saved);
}

// Apply a filterState payload (from saveSettings) onto the state Sets.
function _applyFilterState(fs) {
    if (!fs || typeof fs !== 'object') return;
    const setIf = (set, arr) => {
        if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
            set.clear();
            arr.forEach(v => set.add(String(v)));
        }
    };
    setIf(_selStatus, fs.statuses);
    setIf(_selLG,     fs.locationGroups);
    setIf(_selCat,    fs.categories);
    setIf(_selMO,     fs.moNums);
    setIf(_selPart,   fs.partNums);
    setIf(_selWO,     fs.woNums);
}

// ============================================
// MULTI-SELECT FILTER UI
// Ported from Part/PartActivity.htm. Each filter binds to one of the
// state Sets (_selStatus / _selLG / _selCat / _selMO / _selPart / _selWO)
// and one of the list arrays (_statusList / _lgList / ...). The DOM uses
// the convention ${type}Trigger / ${type}Dropdown / ${type}List /
// ${type}Search / ${type}All / ${type}Clear / ${type}Placeholder.
// ============================================
function msData(type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 'status': return { list: _statusList, sel: _selStatus, ph: 'All statuses' };
        case 'lg':     return { list: _lgList,     sel: _selLG,     ph: 'All location groups' };
        case 'cat':    return { list: _catList,    sel: _selCat,    ph: 'All categories' };
        case 'mo':     return { list: _moList,     sel: _selMO,     ph: 'All MOs' };
        case 'part':   return { list: _partList,   sel: _selPart,   ph: 'All parts' };
        case 'wo':     return { list: _woList,     sel: _selWO,     ph: 'All WOs' };
    }
}

function buildMS(type) {
    const trig = document.getElementById(type + 'Trigger');
    if (!trig) return;
    updateMSTrigger(type);
    trig.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleMS(type); };

    const dd = document.getElementById(type + 'Dropdown');
    if (dd) dd.onclick = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

    const search = document.getElementById(type + 'Search');
    if (search) search.oninput = (e) => renderMSList(type, e.target.value);

    const all = document.getElementById(type + 'All');
    if (all) all.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const { list, sel } = msData(type);
        list.forEach(it => sel.add(it.val));
        updateMSTrigger(type);
        renderMSList(type, search ? search.value : '');
    };

    const clr = document.getElementById(type + 'Clear');
    if (clr) clr.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        msData(type).sel.clear();
        updateMSTrigger(type);
        renderMSList(type, search ? search.value : '');
    };
}

function updateMSTrigger(type) {
    const trig = document.getElementById(type + 'Trigger');
    if (!trig) return;
    const { list, sel, ph } = msData(type);
    if (sel.size === 0) {
        trig.innerHTML = `<span class="ms-placeholder">${ph}</span><span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>`;
        return;
    }
    const tags = [];
    let shown = 0;
    for (const item of list) {
        if (!sel.has(item.val)) continue;
        if (shown < 3) {
            tags.push(`<span class="ms-tag">${item.lbl}<span class="ms-tag-x" data-type="${type}" data-val="${String(item.val).replace(/"/g, '"')}">×</span></span>`);
        }
        shown++;
    }
    if (shown > 3) tags.push(`<span class="ms-tag">+${shown - 3}</span>`);
    trig.innerHTML = tags.join('') + '<span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>';
    trig.querySelectorAll('.ms-tag-x').forEach(x => {
        x.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const t = x.dataset.type, v = x.dataset.val;
            msData(t).sel.delete(v);
            updateMSTrigger(t);
        };
    });
}

function renderMSList(type, search) {
    const listEl = document.getElementById(type + 'List');
    if (!listEl) return;
    const { list: items, sel } = msData(type);
    const term = (search || '').toLowerCase();
    const filtered = items.filter(it =>
        !term || it.lbl.toLowerCase().includes(term) || String(it.val).toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
    if (!filtered.length) {
        listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No matches</div>';
        return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = filtered.map(it => {
        const checked = sel.has(it.val) ? 'checked' : '';
        const safeVal = String(it.val).replace(/"/g, '"');
        return `<label class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox" data-type="${type}" data-val="${safeVal}" ${checked}><span>${it.lbl}</span></label>`;
    }).join('');
    listEl.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb => {
        cb.onchange = () => {
            const t = cb.dataset.type, v = cb.dataset.val;
            const { sel: s } = msData(t);
            if (cb.checked) s.add(v); else s.delete(v);
            updateMSTrigger(t);
        };
    });
}

function toggleMS(type) {
    const dd = document.getElementById(type + 'Dropdown');
    if (!dd) return;
    if (_activeMS === type) { closeMS(); return; }
    closeMS();
    _activeMS = type;
    dd.classList.remove('hidden');
    renderMSList(type, '');
    const search = document.getElementById(type + 'Search');
    if (search) {
        search.value = '';
        setTimeout(() => search.focus(), 10);
    }
}

function closeMS() {
    if (!_activeMS) return;
    const dd = document.getElementById(_activeMS + 'Dropdown');
    if (dd) dd.classList.add('hidden');
    _activeMS = null;
}

function toggleFilters() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('filtersPanel');
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.classList.toggle('open');
    closeMS();
}

// Apply current filter Sets to allWorkOrders → filteredWorkOrders, then re-render.
function applyGanttFilters() {
    closeMS();
    filteredWorkOrders = allWorkOrders.filter(wo => {
        if (_selStatus.size && !_selStatus.has(String(wo.wo_status))) return false;
        if (_selLG.size    && !_selLG.has(String(wo.location_group_id))) return false;
        if (_selCat.size   && !_selCat.has(String(wo.calcategory_id))) return false;
        if (_selMO.size    && !_selMO.has(String(wo.mo_num))) return false;
        if (_selPart.size  && !_selPart.has(String(wo.part_num))) return false;
        if (_selWO.size    && !_selWO.has(String(wo.wo_num))) return false;
        return true;
    });
    debugLog('info', `Filters applied → ${filteredWorkOrders.length}/${allWorkOrders.length} WOs`);
    updateKPIs();
    renderCurrentView();
    // v4: re-render the applied-filter chip strip so it reflects current state.
    if (typeof renderFilterChipStrip === 'function') renderFilterChipStrip();
    // Persist filter state (Phase 4 saves payload)
    if (typeof _persistFilterState === 'function') _persistFilterState();
}

// v4 — Applied-filter chip strip. Walks the six filter Sets and renders a
// removable chip for each active selection. Empty selection sets render
// nothing. Clicking × on a chip clears that single Set's selection (or
// removes one value if there's a single-value form) and re-applies filters.
// The chip strip sits just below the global header.
function renderFilterChipStrip() {
    const strip = document.getElementById('filterChipStrip');
    if (!strip) return;

    // Reset the strip but keep the "+ Add filter" button (it's a sibling).
    // We rebuild everything except the trailing add-button each pass.
    strip.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip, .filter-chip-empty').forEach(el => el.remove());

    const filters = [
        { type: 'status', label: 'Status',         sel: _selStatus, list: _statusList },
        { type: 'lg',     label: 'Location Group', sel: _selLG,     list: _lgList     },
        { type: 'cat',    label: 'Category',       sel: _selCat,    list: _catList    },
        { type: 'mo',     label: 'MO',             sel: _selMO,     list: _moList     },
        { type: 'part',   label: 'Part',           sel: _selPart,   list: _partList   },
        { type: 'wo',     label: 'WO',             sel: _selWO,     list: _woList     },
    ];

    const addBtn = strip.querySelector('.filter-chip-add');
    let totalActive = 0;

    for (const f of filters) {
        if (!f.sel || !f.sel.size) continue;
        totalActive++;
        // Build a comma-separated value string from the selection. Look up
        // labels in the corresponding list so MO/Part/WO show their richer
        // "1234 — FG2100" form, not the bare ID.
        const values = [...f.sel];
        const labels = values.map(v => {
            const item = (f.list || []).find(it => String(it.val) === String(v));
            return item ? item.lbl : v;
        });
        const display = labels.length > 3
            ? `${labels.slice(0, 2).join(', ')} +${labels.length - 2}`
            : labels.join(', ');
        const chip = document.createElement('span');
        chip.className = 'filter-chip';
        chip.title = labels.join(', ');
        chip.innerHTML = `<span class="filter-chip-label">${f.label}:</span><span>${display}</span><span class="filter-chip-x" data-clear-filter="${f.type}" title="Clear ${f.label}">×</span>`;
        strip.insertBefore(chip, addBtn);
    }

    // Empty-state placeholder.
    if (totalActive === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('span');
        empty.className = 'filter-chip-empty';
        empty.textContent = 'No filters applied';
        strip.insertBefore(empty, addBtn);
    }

    // Wire the × buttons to clear their Set + re-apply.
    strip.querySelectorAll('[data-clear-filter]').forEach(x => {
        x.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const type = x.dataset.clearFilter;
            const sel = msData(type)?.sel;
            if (!sel) return;
            sel.clear();
            updateMSTrigger(type);
            applyGanttFilters();
        });
    });
}

// Populate the six filter lists from current allWorkOrders + locationgroup query.
async function populateGanttFilterLists() {
    // Categories from existing categories array (loaded by loadCategories())
    _catList = (typeof categories !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(categories))
        ? categories.map(c => ({ val: String(c.id), lbl: c.name }))
              .sort((a, b) => a.lbl.localeCompare(b.lbl))
        : [];

    // Pre-index manufacturingOrders by mo_num so MO labels can show the
    // finished-good part and BOM number (or "Multiple" when an MO has
    // more than one top-level moitem with distinct BOMs — see schema:
    // moitem.bomId per typeid=50/parentid IS NULL row).
    const moMeta = new Map(); // mo_num -> { fgPart, bomLabel }
    if (Array.isArray(manufacturingOrders)) {
        for (const m of manufacturingOrders) {
            if (!m || !m.mo_num) continue;
            const key = String(m.mo_num);
            let entry = moMeta.get(key);
            if (!entry) { entry = { fgParts: new Set(), boms: new Set() }; moMeta.set(key, entry); }
            if (m.part_num) entry.fgParts.add(m.part_num);
            if (m.bom_num)  entry.boms.add(m.bom_num);
        }
    }

    // Distinct MO / Part / WO from allWorkOrders
    const seenMO = new Set(), seenPart = new Set(), seenWO = new Set();
    _moList = []; _partList = []; _woList = [];
    for (const wo of allWorkOrders) {
        if (wo.mo_num && !seenMO.has(wo.mo_num)) {
            seenMO.add(wo.mo_num);
            const meta = moMeta.get(String(wo.mo_num));
            const fgParts = meta ? [...meta.fgParts] : [];
            const boms    = meta ? [...meta.boms]    : [];
            const fgLabel = fgParts.length > 1 ? 'Multiple' : (fgParts[0] || '');
            const bomLabel = boms.length > 1   ? 'Multiple' : (boms[0] || '');
            const parts = [String(wo.mo_num)];
            if (fgLabel)  parts.push(fgLabel);
            if (bomLabel) parts.push(bomLabel);
            _moList.push({ val: String(wo.mo_num), lbl: parts.join(' — ') });
        }
        if (wo.part_num && !seenPart.has(wo.part_num)) {
            seenPart.add(wo.part_num);
            _partList.push({ val: String(wo.part_num), lbl: String(wo.part_num) });
        }
        if (wo.wo_num && !seenWO.has(wo.wo_num)) {
            seenWO.add(wo.wo_num);
            const lbl = wo.part_num
                ? `${wo.wo_num} — ${wo.part_num}`
                : String(wo.wo_num);
            _woList.push({ val: String(wo.wo_num), lbl });
        }
    }
    // Sort numerically when possible
    const numSort = (a, b) => {
        const na = Number(a.val), nb = Number(b.val);
        if (!isNaN(na) && !isNaN(nb)) return na - nb;
        return a.lbl.localeCompare(b.lbl);
    };
    _moList.sort(numSort); _woList.sort(numSort);
    _partList.sort((a, b) => a.lbl.localeCompare(b.lbl));

    // Location groups — query the table
    try {
        const lgRows = await runQueryAsync(
            'SELECT id, name FROM locationgroup WHERE activeFlag = 1 ORDER BY name'
        );
        _lgList = lgRows.map(r => ({ val: String(r.id), lbl: r.name }));
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('warn', 'Could not load location groups:', e);
        _lgList = [];
    }

    // Rebuild trigger labels for any currently open selections
    ['status', 'lg', 'cat', 'mo', 'part', 'wo'].forEach(updateMSTrigger);
}

// ============================================
// PAGINATION (Phase 5)
// ============================================
function _updatePaginationBar(total, shown) {
    const bar = document.getElementById('paginationBar');
    if (!bar) return;
    if (total <= _pageSize || shown >= total) {
        bar.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    bar.style.display = 'block';
    const status = document.getElementById('paginationStatus');
    if (status) status.textContent = `Showing ${shown} of ${total} MOs · `;
    const moreBtn = document.getElementById('showMoreBtn');
    if (moreBtn) moreBtn.textContent = `Show ${Math.min(_pageSize, total - shown)} more`;
}

function showMoreMOs() {
    _pageOffset += _pageSize;
    renderCurrentView();
}

function showAllMOs() {
    _pageOffset = Infinity;
    renderCurrentView();
}

// ============================================
// AXIS GRANULARITY (Phase 7)
// Changes the column density of the date axis without changing the
// visible date range. 'day' uses the existing pixel-scale; 'week' and
// 'month' set wider per-column widths.
// ============================================
function setAxisGranularity(g) {
    if (!['day', 'week', 'month'].includes(g)) return;
    _axisGranularity = g;
    // Adjust ganttScale so each visible column is roughly column-width wide.
    // For week: 60px per day (1 week = ~7 days = ~420px column). For month:
    // 100px effective per-column — but since the chart still iterates day
    // by day, we set ganttScale to a value that gives ~100px per month.
    // Practically, we keep day-resolution for tile rendering but the date
    // header shows aggregated ticks.
    if (g === 'week') ganttScale = 24;        // 7 days × 24px ≈ 168px per week column
    else if (g === 'month') ganttScale = 6;   // ~30 × 6 ≈ 180px per month column
    else ganttScale = 80;                     // day default
    _updateAxisGranularityButtons();
    renderCurrentView();
    saveSettingsToDatabase();
}

function _updateAxisGranularityButtons() {
    // v4: axis granularity is a .btn-group of .hdr-btn — toggle .active.
    const map = { day: 'axisDayBtn', week: 'axisWeekBtn', month: 'axisMonthBtn' };
    Object.entries(map).forEach(([g, id]) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!btn) return;
        btn.classList.toggle('active', g === _axisGranularity);
    });
}

// ============================================
// STICKY DATE HEADER (Phase 6)
// Renders an HTML strip that mirrors the SVG x-axis ticks and stays
// pinned at the top of #ganttWrapper while the user scrolls vertically.
// Adapts to _axisGranularity ('day' | 'week' | 'month').
// ============================================
function renderGanttDateHeader(xScale, totalWidth, leftMargin) {
    const host = document.getElementById('ganttDateHeader');
    if (!host) return;
    if (!ganttStartDate || !ganttEndDate) {
        host.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }
    host.style.width = totalWidth + 'px';
    // position / top / z-index / background live in the CSS rule for
    // #ganttDateHeader so the corner-cover (z-index 300) and labels
    // overlay (z-index 100) sit in the right order. Don't override here.

    const parts = [];
    const startD = ganttStartDate.clone();
    const endD = ganttEndDate.clone();
    const today = moment().startOf('day');

    if (_axisGranularity === 'month') {
        let cur = startD.clone().startOf('month');
        while (cur.isSameOrBefore(endD)) {
            const colStart = moment.max(cur, startD);
            const colEnd = moment.min(cur.clone().endOf('month'), endD);
            const x = xScale(colStart.toDate());
            const w = Math.max(40, xScale(colEnd.clone().add(1, 'day').toDate()) - x);
            const cls = today.isBetween(colStart, colEnd, 'day', '[]') ? ' today' : '';
            parts.push(`<div class="gantt-tick${cls}" style="left:${x}px;width:${w}px;">
                <div class="gantt-tick-major">${cur.format('YYYY')}</div>
                <div class="gantt-tick-minor">${cur.format('MMM')}</div>
            </div>`);
            cur.add(1, 'month');
        }
    } else if (_axisGranularity === 'week') {
        let cur = startD.clone().startOf('isoWeek');
        while (cur.isSameOrBefore(endD)) {
            const colStart = moment.max(cur, startD);
            const colEnd = moment.min(cur.clone().endOf('isoWeek'), endD);
            const x = xScale(colStart.toDate());
            const w = Math.max(40, xScale(colEnd.clone().add(1, 'day').toDate()) - x);
            const cls = today.isBetween(colStart, colEnd, 'day', '[]') ? ' today' : '';
            parts.push(`<div class="gantt-tick${cls}" style="left:${x}px;width:${w}px;">
                <div class="gantt-tick-major">${cur.format('MMM')}</div>
                <div class="gantt-tick-minor">W${cur.isoWeek()}</div>
            </div>`);
            cur.add(1, 'week');
        }
    } else {
        // Day granularity (default) — one tick per day, with month band at top
        let cur = startD.clone();
        while (cur.isSameOrBefore(endD)) {
            const x = xScale(cur.toDate());
            const next = cur.clone().add(1, 'day');
            const w = Math.max(20, xScale(next.toDate()) - x);
            const isWeekend = cur.day() === 0 || cur.day() === 6;
            const isToday = today.isSame(cur, 'day');
            const cls = (isWeekend ? ' weekend' : '') + (isToday ? ' today' : '');
            // Show month name only on the 1st (or first visible day of a month)
            const showMonth = cur.date() === 1 || cur.isSame(startD, 'day');
            parts.push(`<div class="gantt-tick${cls}" style="left:${x}px;width:${w}px;">
                <div class="gantt-tick-major">${showMonth ? cur.format('MMM') : ' '}</div>
                <div class="gantt-tick-minor">${cur.format('D')}</div>
            </div>`);
            cur = next;
        }
    }
    host.innerHTML = parts.join('');
}
