// ============================================
// AUTO-SCHEDULE (Phase 3)
// ============================================
// The auto-scheduler walks WOs in priority (and optionally dependency)
// order, placing each into the earliest day where its category has
// capacity. Results are staged in _pendingScheduleChanges and the user
// can preview Current/New/Both before committing to Fishbowl via the
// schedule save bar.

// Persisted options (mirrored to saveSettings via saveSettingsToDatabase)
let _schedulerMethod     = 'dependency';     // 'dependency' | 'priority'
let _schedulerPlacement  = 'balanced';        // 'balanced' | 'compact'
let _schedulerScope      = 'unscheduled';     // 'unscheduled' | 'reschedule'
let _schedulerWindowDays = 30;

// Runtime state — not persisted
let _pendingScheduleChanges = {}; // wo_id → {wo_num, originalStart, originalEnd, newStart, newEnd}
let _scheduleDiffMode = 'both';   // 'current' | 'new' | 'both'
let _scheduleSnapshot = null;     // before-snapshot for metrics
let _calendarExpanded = false;    // larger-calendar toggle

// ---------- UI toggles ----------------------------------------------

function toggleAutoSchedulePanel() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('autoSchedulePanel');
    if (!panel) return;
    const isOpen = panel.style.display !== 'none';
    panel.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : '';
    if (!isOpen) {
        document.getElementById('autoSchedMethod').value     = _schedulerMethod;
        document.getElementById('autoSchedPlacement').value  = _schedulerPlacement;
        document.getElementById('autoSchedScope').value      = _schedulerScope;
        document.getElementById('autoSchedWindowDays').value = _schedulerWindowDays;
        _onAutoSchedScopeChange();
    }
}

function _onAutoSchedScopeChange() {
    const scope = document.getElementById('autoSchedScope').value;
    const wrap  = document.getElementById('autoSchedWindowWrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = scope === 'reschedule' ? '' : 'none';
}

function toggleCalendarExpanded() {
    _calendarExpanded = !_calendarExpanded;
    debugLog('info', `Expand calendar toggled → ${_calendarExpanded ? 'EXPANDED' : 'compact'}`);
    _applyCalendarExpandedState();
    if (typeof saveSettingsToDatabase === 'function') saveSettingsToDatabase();
}

// Apply the visual side-effects of _calendarExpanded. Split out so the
// auto-expand path (in runAutoSchedule) can set _calendarExpanded directly
// and call this without going through the toggle.
function _applyCalendarExpandedState() {
    const expanded = _calendarExpanded;
    const lbl = document.getElementById('expandCalendarLabel');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = expanded ? 'Compact calendar' : 'Expand calendar';

    // The compact mode uses `margin-left: 82px` on #monthCalendar to align
    // the single month with the SVG capacity grid below. Expanded mode
    // hides the capacity grid, so kill the offset — otherwise the 3-month
    // strip is shoved right and the heatmap looks unaligned.
    const cal = document.getElementById('monthCalendar');
    if (cal) {
        cal.style.minHeight = '';
        cal.style.marginLeft = expanded ? '0' : '82px';
    }

    // Weekly capacity card is hidden when expanded (the heatmap replaces it).
    let weeklyCardFound = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('#capacityContainer h3').forEach(h => {
        if (h.textContent.trim() === 'Weekly Capacity Planning') {
            const card = h.closest('.bg-white');
            if (card) {
                card.style.display = expanded ? 'none' : '';
                weeklyCardFound = true;
            }
        }
    });

    const heatmapCard = document.getElementById('capacityHeatmapCard');
    if (heatmapCard) {
        heatmapCard.style.display = expanded ? '' : 'none';
    } else {
        debugLog('warn', '#capacityHeatmapCard not found in DOM');
    }

    debugLog('info', `applyCalendarExpandedState: weeklyCard=${weeklyCardFound}, heatmapCard=${!!heatmapCard}, monthCalendar=${!!cal}`);

    // Rebuild the calendar so the layout flips between single-month and
    // multi-month + heatmap.
    if (typeof buildMonthCalendar === 'function') buildMonthCalendar();
}

// ---------- Priority scoring ----------------------------------------

// Lower score = more urgent. Same shape as the proof's formula:
//   priorityId × 10 (1=High, 3=Normal, 5=Low) → coarse band
// + clamp(daysUntilMoDue, -30, +30)            → secondary
// - daysSinceCreated × 0.1                       → small tie-breaker
function priorityScore(wo) {
    const priorityId = parseInt(wo.priorityid, 10) || 3;
    const moData = manufacturingOrders.find(m => m.mo_num === wo.mo_num);
    const moDue = (moData && moData.mo_date_scheduled) ? moment(moData.mo_date_scheduled) : null;
    let dueUrgency = 15;
    if (moDue && moDue.isValid()) {
        const days = Math.round((moDue.valueOf() - moment().valueOf()) / 86400000);
        dueUrgency = Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, days));
    }
    const created = wo.datecreated ? moment(wo.datecreated) : null;
    const ageDays = (created && created.isValid())
        ? Math.round((moment().valueOf() - created.valueOf()) / 86400000)
        : 0;
    return (priorityId * 10) + dueUrgency - (ageDays * 0.1);
}

// Comparator used by the auto-scheduler to order the placement queue.
// Primary key: the WO's *original* scheduled start (most-overdue / earliest
// first). Without this, every overdue WO has the same `earliestStart` of
// "today" and they all collapse onto the same first viable day.
// Secondary key: priorityScore (lower = more urgent).
// Tertiary key: wo_num (stable order for unscheduled WOs that share a
// priority).
function _autoSchedComparator(a, b) {
    const ta = a.date_scheduled_start ? moment(a.date_scheduled_start).valueOf() : null;
    const tb = b.date_scheduled_start ? moment(b.date_scheduled_start).valueOf() : null;
    if (ta != null && tb != null) {
        if (ta !== tb) return ta - tb;
    } else if (ta != null) {
        return -1; // scheduled-then-overdue WOs come before truly unscheduled
    } else if (tb != null) {
        return 1;
    }
    const ps = priorityScore(a) - priorityScore(b);
    if (Math.abs(ps) > 0.001) return ps;
    return String(a.wo_num).localeCompare(String(b.wo_num));
}

// ---------- Day-load tracking ---------------------------------------

function _dayLoadKey(catId, dayMoment) {
    return `${catId}|${dayMoment.format('YYYY-MM-DD')}`;
}

function _addToDayLoad(dayLoad, wo, startDay, endDay) {
    const labour = parseFloat(wo.labourHours) || 0;
    if (labour <= 0) return;
    const days = [];
    const cur = startDay.clone().startOf('day');
    const end = endDay.clone().startOf('day');
    while (cur.isSameOrBefore(end)) {
        if (!skipWeekends || (cur.day() !== 0 && cur.day() !== 6)) days.push(cur.clone());
        cur.add(1, 'day');
    }
    if (days.length === 0) return;
    const perDay = labour / days.length;
    for (const d of days) {
        const key = _dayLoadKey(wo.calcategory_id, d);
        dayLoad.set(key, (dayLoad.get(key) || 0) + perDay);
    }
}

// ---------- Placement ------------------------------------------------

// Find the earliest viable (day, category) slot for a single WO.
// Returns { success, start, end } or { success: false, reason }.
function _placeWO(wo, dayLoad, depFinishMap, options) {
    const catId = wo.calcategory_id;
    const cat = capacitySettings.categories.find(c => c.id === catId);
    if (!cat) return { success: false, reason: 'no-category' };

    const labour  = parseFloat(wo.labourHours)  || 0.5;
    const elapsed = parseFloat(wo.elapsedHours) || labour;

    // Earliest start: today, bumped forward by supplier finish dates (dep mode).
    let earliestStart = moment().startOf('day');
    if (options.method === 'dependency') {
        const deps = stagingDependencies.filter(d => d.wo_id === wo.wo_id);
        for (const dep of deps) {
            const supEnd = depFinishMap.get(dep.staging_wo_id);
            if (supEnd) {
                let after = supEnd.clone().add(allowSameDayStarts ? 0 : 1, 'day');
                while (skipWeekends && (after.day() === 0 || after.day() === 6)) after.add(1, 'day');
                if (after.isAfter(earliestStart)) earliestStart = after;
            }
        }
    }

    // Walk forward looking for the best day to place this WO. Both modes
    // scan a 14-day lookahead window of viable days (not 14 calendar days —
    // skipped weekends / closed days don't count). Strict `<` on the score
    // means ties go to the earlier day, so we never push out further than
    // needed.
    //   Balanced: lowest current load wins → spreads WOs across days
    //   Compact:  tightest fit (smallest remaining after placement) wins
    //             → packs days densely starting from earliest
    // The previous balanced implementation broke out on the first viable
    // day, which caused every overdue WO (all sharing earliestStart=today)
    // to collapse onto the same day.
    const elapsedDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(elapsed / 8));
    const labourDays  = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(labour / 8));
    const perDay = labour / Math.max(1, labourDays);
    const lookaheadDays = 14;
    let bestStart = null;
    let bestScore = Infinity;
    let viableSeen = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 365; i++) {
        const day = earliestStart.clone().add(i, 'days');
        if (skipWeekends && (day.day() === 0 || day.day() === 6)) continue;

        const dayCap = cat.limits[day.isoWeekday() - 1];
        if (dayCap <= 0) continue;

        const currentLoad = dayLoad.get(_dayLoadKey(catId, day)) || 0;
        const remaining = dayCap - currentLoad;
        if (remaining < perDay - 0.001) continue;

        const score = options.placement === 'compact'
            ? (remaining - perDay)  // smaller leftover slack = tighter fit
            : currentLoad;          // lower current load = balanced spread

        if (score < bestScore - 0.001) {
            bestScore = score;
            bestStart = day.clone();
        }
        viableSeen++;
        if (viableSeen >= lookaheadDays) break;
    }

    if (!bestStart) return { success: false, reason: 'no-capacity' };

    // Compute end = bestStart + (elapsedDays - 1) working days
    let end = bestStart.clone();
    let added = 0;
    while (added < elapsedDays - 1) {
        end.add(1, 'day');
        if (!skipWeekends || (end.day() !== 0 && end.day() !== 6)) added++;
    }
    return { success: true, start: bestStart, end };
}

// ---------- Snapshots & metrics --------------------------------------

function _computeScheduleSnapshot() {
    // Capacity overages — count category-day pairs over cap in next 90d
    let capacityOverages = 0;
    const today = moment();
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
        const checkDay = today.clone().add(i, 'days');
        const dow = checkDay.isoWeekday() - 1;
        for (const cat of capacitySettings.categories) {
            const cap = cat.limits[dow];
            if (cap <= 0) continue;
            const { usage } = getUsageForCategoryAndDay(cat.id, checkDay);
            if (usage > cap) capacityOverages++;
        }
    }
    // Dependency conflicts
    let dependencyConflicts = 0;
    for (const dep of stagingDependencies) {
        const sup = allWorkOrders.find(w => w.wo_id === dep.staging_wo_id);
        const con = allWorkOrders.find(w => w.wo_id === dep.wo_id);
        if (!sup || !con) continue;
        const supEnd = moment(sup.date_scheduled);
        const conStart = moment(con.date_scheduled_start);
        if (supEnd.isValid() && conStart.isValid()) {
            const violate = allowSameDayStarts ? supEnd.isAfter(conStart) : supEnd.isSameOrAfter(conStart);
            if (violate) dependencyConflicts++;
        }
    }
    const unscheduledCount = allWorkOrders.filter(isUnscheduled).length;
    return { capacityOverages, dependencyConflicts, unscheduledCount };
}

// Like _computeScheduleSnapshot but overlays _pendingScheduleChanges on top.
function _computeProjectedSnapshot() {
    const overlay = new Map();
    for (const [woId, ch] of Object.entries(_pendingScheduleChanges)) {
        overlay.set(parseInt(woId, 10), ch);
    }
    const eff = (wo) => {
        const ch = overlay.get(wo.wo_id);
        return ch
            ? { start: moment(ch.newStart), end: moment(ch.newEnd) }
            : { start: moment(wo.date_scheduled_start), end: moment(wo.date_scheduled) };
    };

    let capacityOverages = 0;
    const today = moment();
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
        const checkDay = today.clone().add(i, 'days');
        const dow = checkDay.isoWeekday() - 1;
        for (const cat of capacitySettings.categories) {
            const cap = cat.limits[dow];
            if (cap <= 0) continue;
            let usage = 0;
            for (const wo of allWorkOrders) {
                if (wo.calcategory_id !== cat.id) continue;
                if (!showCompletedWOs && wo.wo_status === 40) continue;
                const e = eff(wo);
                if (!e.start.isValid() || !e.end.isValid()) continue;
                const s = e.start.clone().startOf('day');
                const en = e.end.clone().startOf('day');
                if (checkDay.isSameOrAfter(s) && checkDay.isSameOrBefore(en)) {
                    if (skipWeekends && (checkDay.day() === 0 || checkDay.day() === 6)) continue;
                    const labour = parseFloat(wo.labourHours) || 0;
                    const daysIn = skipWeekends ? countWeekdaysInRange(s, en) : (en.diff(s, 'days') + 1);
                    if (daysIn > 0) usage += labour / daysIn;
                }
            }
            if (usage > cap) capacityOverages++;
        }
    }
    let dependencyConflicts = 0;
    for (const dep of stagingDependencies) {
        const sup = allWorkOrders.find(w => w.wo_id === dep.staging_wo_id);
        const con = allWorkOrders.find(w => w.wo_id === dep.wo_id);
        if (!sup || !con) continue;
        const supE = eff(sup);
        const conE = eff(con);
        if (supE.end.isValid() && conE.start.isValid()) {
            const violate = allowSameDayStarts ? supE.end.isAfter(conE.start) : supE.end.isSameOrAfter(conE.start);
            if (violate) dependencyConflicts++;
        }
    }
    // A pending WO is considered "scheduled" after the change
    const unscheduledCount = allWorkOrders.filter(wo => {
        if (overlay.has(wo.wo_id)) return false;
        return isUnscheduled(wo);
    }).length;
    return { capacityOverages, dependencyConflicts, unscheduledCount };
}

// ---------- Main entry point -----------------------------------------

async function runAutoSchedule() {
    const method     = document.getElementById('autoSchedMethod').value;
    const placement  = document.getElementById('autoSchedPlacement').value;
    const scope      = document.getElementById('autoSchedScope').value;
    const windowDays = parseInt(document.getElementById('autoSchedWindowDays').value, 10) || 30;
    _schedulerMethod     = method;
    _schedulerPlacement  = placement;
    _schedulerScope      = scope;
    _schedulerWindowDays = windowDays;
    saveSettingsToDatabase();

    debugLog('info', `Auto-Schedule: method=${method}, placement=${placement}, scope=${scope}, window=${windowDays}d`);

    // 1. Snapshot before-state
    _scheduleSnapshot = _computeScheduleSnapshot();

    // 2. Split allWorkOrders into pool (placeable) + frozen (capacity counted, untouched)
    const windowEnd = moment().add(windowDays, 'days').endOf('day');
    const pool = [];
    const frozen = [];
    for (const wo of allWorkOrders) {
        if (wo.wo_status === 30 || wo.wo_status === 40) { frozen.push(wo); continue; }
        if (scope === 'unscheduled') {
            if (isUnscheduled(wo)) pool.push(wo); else frozen.push(wo);
        } else {
            if (isUnscheduled(wo)) { pool.push(wo); continue; }
            const s = moment(wo.date_scheduled_start);
            if (s.isValid() && s.isSameOrBefore(windowEnd)) pool.push(wo);
            else frozen.push(wo);
        }
    }
    debugLog('info', `Pool: ${pool.length} placeable, ${frozen.length} frozen`);

    // 3. Order the pool. Both modes use the same (originalDate, priority,
    //    wo_num) tie-break — dependency-aware applies it within each topo
    //    level so suppliers still precede consumers. The original-date
    //    primary key is what prevents every overdue WO from collapsing
    //    onto the same first viable day (they used to all carry the same
    //    `earliestStart = today` and lose all sequencing).
    let orderedPool;
    if (method === 'dependency') {
        orderedPool = sortWOsByDependencies(pool, _autoSchedComparator);
    } else {
        orderedPool = [...pool].sort(_autoSchedComparator);
    }

    // 4. Initialise dayLoad from frozen WOs (their labour is already booked)
    const dayLoad = new Map();
    for (const wo of frozen) {
        if (!wo.date_scheduled_start || !wo.date_scheduled) continue;
        const s = moment(wo.date_scheduled_start);
        const e = moment(wo.date_scheduled);
        if (s.isValid() && e.isValid()) _addToDayLoad(dayLoad, wo, s, e);
    }

    // 5. Build depFinish map seeded with frozen WOs' end dates
    const depFinish = new Map();
    for (const wo of frozen) {
        const e = moment(wo.date_scheduled);
        if (e.isValid()) depFinish.set(wo.wo_id, e.clone().startOf('day'));
    }

    // 6. Place each pool WO in order
    _pendingScheduleChanges = {};
    let placed = 0;
    let unchanged = 0;
    const unplaced = [];
    const options = { method, placement };

    for (const wo of orderedPool) {
        const r = _placeWO(wo, dayLoad, depFinish, options);
        if (!r.success) {
            unplaced.push(wo.wo_num);
            continue;
        }
        depFinish.set(wo.wo_id, r.end.clone().startOf('day'));
        _addToDayLoad(dayLoad, wo, r.start, r.end);

        const newStartStr = r.start.format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        const newEndStr   = r.end.format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        const oldStartStr = wo.date_scheduled_start ? moment(wo.date_scheduled_start).format('YYYY-MM-DD') : null;
        const oldEndStr   = wo.date_scheduled       ? moment(wo.date_scheduled).format('YYYY-MM-DD')       : null;
        if (oldStartStr === newStartStr && oldEndStr === newEndStr) { unchanged++; continue; }

        _pendingScheduleChanges[wo.wo_id] = {
            wo_id:         wo.wo_id,
            wo_num:        wo.wo_num,
            originalStart: wo.date_scheduled_start,
            originalEnd:   wo.date_scheduled,
            newStart:      newStartStr,
            newEnd:        newEndStr,
        };
        placed++;
    }

    debugLog('success', `Auto-Schedule: ${placed} moved, ${unchanged} unchanged, ${unplaced.length} unplaceable`);

    // 7. Auto-expand if the pending changes span more than 1 month. This
    //    swaps the single-month calendar for the 3-month strip + heatmap
    //    so the user can see the whole reshuffle in one shot, anchored on
    //    the midpoint of the change window.
    if (placed > 0 && !_calendarExpanded) {
        let earliest = null, latest = null;
        for (const ch of Object.values(_pendingScheduleChanges)) {
            const s = moment(ch.newStart);
            const e = moment(ch.newEnd);
            if (s.isValid() && (!earliest || s.isBefore(earliest))) earliest = s.clone();
            if (e.isValid() && (!latest   || e.isAfter(latest)))    latest   = e.clone();
        }
        if (earliest && latest) {
            const spanDays = latest.diff(earliest, 'days');
            if (spanDays > 28) {
                currentCalendarMonth = earliest.clone().add(Math.floor(spanDays / 2), 'days');
                _calendarExpanded = true;
                _applyCalendarExpandedState();   // shows heatmap, hides weekly, rebuilds calendar
            }
        }
    }

    // 8. Close panel, default diff mode to 'both', re-render
    document.getElementById('autoSchedulePanel').style.display = 'none';
    _scheduleDiffMode = 'both';
    renderCurrentView();
    renderScheduleSaveBar();

    if (placed === 0) {
        const msg = unchanged > 0
            ? `Auto-Schedule produced no movement — ${unchanged} WO(s) already at optimal placement`
            : 'Auto-Schedule produced no changes';
        showToast(msg, 'info', 5000);
    } else {
        let msg = `Auto-Schedule: ${placed} WO${placed > 1 ? 's' : ''} moved`;
        if (unplaced.length > 0) msg += `, ${unplaced.length} couldn't fit (extend window or capacity)`;
        showToast(msg, 'success', 6000);
    }
}

// ---------- Save bar + diff mode -------------------------------------

function renderScheduleSaveBar() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('scheduleSaveBar');
    if (!bar) return;
    const count = Object.keys(_pendingScheduleChanges).length;
    if (count === 0) {
        bar.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    // v4: bar is inline (not position:fixed) — no paddingBottom hack needed.
    bar.style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('schedulePendingCount').textContent = count;

    // Highlight active diff-mode button via .active (now a .btn-group).
    bar.querySelectorAll('#scheduleDiffToggle .hdr-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.mode === _scheduleDiffMode);
    });

    // Metrics: before → after, colour-coded
    const before = _scheduleSnapshot || { capacityOverages: 0, dependencyConflicts: 0, unscheduledCount: 0 };
    const after  = _computeProjectedSnapshot();
    const fmt = (b, a) => {
        const delta = a - b;
        const colour = delta < 0 ? '#34d399' : (delta > 0 ? '#fca5a5' : '#94a3b8');
        const arrow  = delta < 0 ? '↓' : (delta > 0 ? '↑' : '=');
        const mag    = Math.abs(delta) || '';
        return `<span style="color:${colour};font-weight:600;">${b} → ${a} ${arrow}${mag}</span>`;
    };
    const metricsEl = document.getElementById('scheduleMetrics');
    if (metricsEl) {
        metricsEl.innerHTML = `
            <span>Capacity overages: ${fmt(before.capacityOverages, after.capacityOverages)}</span>
            <span class="text-slate-600">·</span>
            <span>Dependency conflicts: ${fmt(before.dependencyConflicts, after.dependencyConflicts)}</span>
            <span class="text-slate-600">·</span>
            <span>Unscheduled: ${fmt(before.unscheduledCount, after.unscheduledCount)}</span>
        `;
    }
}

function setScheduleDiffMode(mode) {
    if (!['current', 'new', 'both'].includes(mode)) return;
    _scheduleDiffMode = mode;
    renderCurrentView();
    renderScheduleSaveBar();
}

// Overlay-aware day usage. When there are pending changes and the diff mode
// is 'new' or 'both', returns labour usage with the pending WO positions
// applied. Otherwise returns the saved-schedule usage. Used by the calendar
// day-cell totals so they stay consistent with the visible tile positions.
function _usageForCategoryAndDayProjected(catId, dayMoment) {
    const noPending = !_pendingScheduleChanges || Object.keys(_pendingScheduleChanges).length === 0;
    if (noPending || _scheduleDiffMode === 'current') {
        return getUsageForCategoryAndDay(catId, dayMoment).usage;
    }
    const checkDay = dayMoment.clone().startOf('day');
    if (skipWeekends && (checkDay.day() === 0 || checkDay.day() === 6)) return 0;
    let usage = 0;
    for (const wo of filteredWorkOrders) {
        if (!showCompletedWOs && wo.wo_status === 40) continue;
        if (wo.calcategory_id !== catId) continue;
        const ch = _pendingScheduleChanges[wo.wo_id];
        const s = ch ? moment(ch.newStart) : moment(wo.date_scheduled_start);
        let e   = ch ? moment(ch.newEnd)   : moment(wo.date_scheduled);
        if (!ch && wo.wo_status === 40 && wo.date_finished) {
            const df = moment(wo.date_finished);
            if (df.isValid()) e = moment.min(e, df);
        }
        if (!s.isValid() || !e.isValid()) continue;
        const sd = s.clone().startOf('day');
        const ed = e.clone().startOf('day');
        if (checkDay.isSameOrAfter(sd) && checkDay.isSameOrBefore(ed)) {
            const labour = parseFloat(wo.labourHours) || 0;
            const days = skipWeekends ? countWeekdaysInRange(sd, ed) : (ed.diff(sd, 'days') + 1);
            if (days > 0) usage += labour / days;
        }
    }
    return usage;
}

async function saveScheduleChanges() {
    const changes = Object.values(_pendingScheduleChanges);
    if (changes.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm(`Save ${changes.length} schedule change${changes.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} to Fishbowl?`)) return;

    // Single progress toast that ticks "Saving N of T…" instead of spawning
    // one toast per WO. saveWODates is called with silent=true so it
    // skips its own per-WO toast + reload — we run one reload at the end.
    const total = changes.length;
    const progress = showProgressToast(`Saving 0 of ${total}…`, 'info');
    let saved = 0, failed = 0;
    for (const ch of changes) {
        try {
            const ok = await saveWODates(ch.wo_num, ch.newStart, ch.newEnd, /*silent*/ true);
            if (ok) saved++; else failed++;
        } catch (e) {
            failed++;
            debugLog('error', `Save failed for WO ${ch.wo_num}: ${e.message}`);
        }
        const done = saved + failed;
        const tail = failed > 0 ? ` (${failed} failed)` : '';
        progress.update(`Saving ${done} of ${total}…${tail}`);
    }
    _pendingScheduleChanges = {};
    _scheduleSnapshot = null;
    renderScheduleSaveBar();

    // One reload at the end so the saved positions appear in the views.
    // Preserve the current capacity-view scroll so the reload doesn't jump.
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('ganttWrapper');
    const scrollLeft = wrapper ? wrapper.scrollLeft : 0;
    const scrollTop  = wrapper ? wrapper.scrollTop  : 0;
    window.skipAutoScroll = true;
    loadWorkOrders();
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (wrapper) { wrapper.scrollLeft = scrollLeft; wrapper.scrollTop = scrollTop; }
        window.skipAutoScroll = false;
    }, 150);

    if (failed === 0) {
        progress.close(`✓ Saved ${saved} WO${saved !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`, 'success', 4000);
    } else {
        progress.close(`${saved} saved, ${failed} failed`, 'error', 6000);
    }
}

function discardScheduleChanges() {
    const count = Object.keys(_pendingScheduleChanges).length;
    if (count === 0) return;
    if (!confirm(`Discard ${count} pending schedule change${count > 1 ? 's' : ''}?`)) return;
    _pendingScheduleChanges = {};
    _scheduleSnapshot = null;
    renderCurrentView();
    renderScheduleSaveBar();
    showToast('Discarded', 'info', 2500);
}

async function handleCalendarWODrop(dragData, dropDateStr) {
    // Find the WO in allWorkOrders
    const wo = allWorkOrders.find(w => w.wo_id === dragData.wo_id);
    if (!wo) {
        debugLog('error', `WO ${dragData.wo_num} not found in allWorkOrders`);
        return;
    }

    const dropDate = moment(dropDateStr);
    const fromDrawer = dragData.source === 'drawer';
    const hasOriginal = !!(dragData.originalStart && dragData.originalEnd);

    let newStart, newEnd;

    if (fromDrawer && !hasOriginal) {
        // Truly unscheduled WO from the drawer — no prior dates to shift.
        // Place the WO starting on the drop date. Estimate span from the
        // WO's elapsed hours (BOM duration if present, else labour hours)
        // assuming ~8 working hours per day; minimum 1 day, capped at 14
        // so a malformed BOM can't produce a 6-month bar.
        const elapsed = Number(wo.elapsedHours || wo.labourHours || 1);
        const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(14, Math.ceil(elapsed / 8)));
        newStart = dropDate.clone();
        newEnd   = newStart.clone().add(days - 1, 'days');
        debugLog('info', `Scheduling WO ${dragData.wo_num} fresh from drawer: ${newStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD')} → ${newEnd.format('YYYY-MM-DD')} (${days}d for ${elapsed.toFixed(1)}h elapsed)`);
    } else {
        // Already-scheduled WO — keep the WO's duration constant and shift
        // both ends by the same delta. Drop date defines the new start.
        const originalStart = moment(dragData.originalStart);
        const originalEnd   = moment(dragData.originalEnd);
        const daysDiff = dropDate.diff(originalStart, 'days');
        if (daysDiff === 0) {
            debugLog('info', `WO ${dragData.wo_num} dropped on same date, no change needed`);
            return;
        }
        newStart = originalStart.clone().add(daysDiff, 'days');
        newEnd   = originalEnd.clone().add(daysDiff, 'days');
        debugLog('info', `Moving WO ${dragData.wo_num} by ${daysDiff} days: ${originalStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD')} → ${newStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD')}`);
    }

    // Save to database using the async function
    await saveWODates(dragData.wo_num, newStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), newEnd.format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
}

async function handleCapacityWODrop(wo, targetDay, targetCategory, currentWeekStart) {
    debugLog('info', `handleCapacityWODrop called for WO ${wo.wo_num}, targetCategory: ${targetCategory ? targetCategory.name + ' (ID: ' + targetCategory.id + ')' : 'null'}`);

    let hasChanges = false;
    const changes = [];
    let newStart, newEnd;

    // Handle date change
    if (targetDay) {
        const originalStart = moment(wo.date_scheduled_start);
        const originalEnd = moment(wo.date_scheduled);
        const daysDiff = targetDay.diff(originalStart.startOf('day'), 'days');

        if (daysDiff !== 0) {
            newStart = originalStart.clone().add(daysDiff, 'days');
            newEnd = originalEnd.clone().add(daysDiff, 'days');

            changes.push(`date: ${originalStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD')} → ${newStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD')}`);
            hasChanges = true;
        }
    }

    // Handle category change
    let categoryChanged = false;
    if (targetCategory && targetCategory.id !== wo.calcategory_id) {
        const oldCategoryName = wo.calendar_category || 'Uncategorized';
        changes.push(`category: ${oldCategoryName} → ${targetCategory.name}`);
        categoryChanged = true;
        hasChanges = true;
        debugLog('info', `Category change detected: ${oldCategoryName} (ID: ${wo.calcategory_id}) → ${targetCategory.name} (ID: ${targetCategory.id})`);
    } else if (targetCategory) {
        debugLog('info', `No category change - target ${targetCategory.id} is same as current ${wo.calcategory_id}`);
    }

    if (hasChanges) {
        debugLog('info', `Moving WO ${wo.wo_num}: ${changes.join(', ')}`);

        // Save date changes first if any
        if (newStart && newEnd) {
            debugLog('info', `Calling saveWODates for WO ${wo.wo_num}`);
            await saveWODates(wo.wo_num, newStart.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), newEnd.format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
        }

        // Then save category change if any
        if (categoryChanged) {
            debugLog('info', `Calling saveWOCategory for WO ${wo.wo_num} with category ID ${targetCategory.id}`);
            await saveWOCategory(wo.wo_num, targetCategory.id);
        }

        // Reload work orders to reflect changes
        debugLog('info', `Reloading work orders after WO ${wo.wo_num} changes`);
        loadWorkOrders();
    } else {
        debugLog('info', `WO ${wo.wo_num} dropped with no changes`);
        renderCurrentView(); // Still refresh to snap back to original position
    }
}

// Single-month calendar (compact) when _calendarExpanded = false; in expanded
// mode, three side-by-side mini-calendars (previous, current, next month)
// plus the capacity-heatmap card. Tiles for each month are rendered after
// the table is in the DOM so column widths are settled.
function buildMonthCalendar() {
    const container = document.getElementById('monthCalendar');
    if (!container) {
        debugLog('warn', 'buildMonthCalendar: #monthCalendar container missing');
        return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = '';

    _updateCalendarHeader();

    debugLog('info', `buildMonthCalendar: mode=${_calendarExpanded ? 'EXPANDED (3 months)' : 'compact (1 month)'}, anchor=${currentCalendarMonth.format('MMM YYYY')}`);

    if (_calendarExpanded) {
        // Multi-month strip: prev / current / next, side-by-side. minmax(0, 1fr)
        // lets columns shrink to fit the viewport — at 1080p the strip
        // squeezes into the available width rather than overflowing into a
        // horizontal scrollbar. Cell sizes auto-flex via `table-layout: fixed`
        // inside _buildSingleMonthTable.
        const strip = document.createElement('div');
        strip.style.display = 'grid';
        strip.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))';
        strip.style.gap = '0.5rem';
        strip.style.alignItems = 'flex-start';
        strip.style.width = '100%';

        const months = [
            currentCalendarMonth.clone().subtract(1, 'month'),
            currentCalendarMonth.clone(),
            currentCalendarMonth.clone().add(1, 'month'),
        ];
        const tables = [];
        for (const m of months) {
            const monthCol = document.createElement('div');
            monthCol.style.minWidth = '0';

            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'text-center text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1';
            header.textContent = m.format('MMMM YYYY');
            monthCol.appendChild(header);

            const table = _buildSingleMonthTable(m, /*compact*/true);
            monthCol.appendChild(table);
            strip.appendChild(monthCol);
            tables.push(table);
        }
        container.appendChild(strip);
        debugLog('info', `buildMonthCalendar: rendered 3-month strip (${months.map(m => m.format('MMM')).join(' | ')}), strip width=${strip.offsetWidth}px`);

        // Render WOs into each month after the DOM is in place so each table
        // can read its own column widths.
        months.forEach((m, idx) => {
            const calStart = m.clone().startOf('month').startOf('isoWeek');
            renderCalendarWOs(tables[idx], calStart);
        });

        // Heatmap below the strip
        renderCapacityHeatmap();
    } else {
        // Single month — original behaviour
        const table = _buildSingleMonthTable(currentCalendarMonth, false);
        container.appendChild(table);
        const calendarStart = currentCalendarMonth.clone().startOf('month').startOf('isoWeek');
        renderCalendarWOs(table, calendarStart);
    }
}

// Update the calendar's month-display span. Shows the single month in
// compact mode, the 3-month range in expanded mode.
function _updateCalendarHeader() {
    const display = document.getElementById('calendarMonthDisplay');
    if (!display) return;
    if (_calendarExpanded) {
        const start = currentCalendarMonth.clone().subtract(1, 'month');
        const end   = currentCalendarMonth.clone().add(1, 'month');
        display.textContent = start.year() === end.year()
            ? `${start.format('MMMM')} – ${end.format('MMMM YYYY')}`
            : `${start.format('MMM YYYY')} – ${end.format('MMM YYYY')}`;
    } else {
        display.textContent = currentCalendarMonth.format('MMMM YYYY');
    }
}

// Build the table for one month and return it. Compact mode tightens the
// cell padding / font sizes so three months fit at 1080p.
//
// The caller is responsible for calling renderCalendarWOs() after the
// table is in the DOM (so the WO tiles can size against real cell widths).
function _buildSingleMonthTable(monthMoment, compact) {
    const monthStart = monthMoment.clone().startOf('month');
    const monthEnd   = monthMoment.clone().endOf('month');
    const calendarStart = monthStart.clone().startOf('isoWeek');
    const calendarEnd   = monthEnd.clone().endOf('isoWeek');
    const totalDays = calendarEnd.diff(calendarStart, 'days') + 1;
    const numWeeks  = Math.ceil(totalDays / 7);

    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'w-full border-collapse';
    // `table-layout: fixed` makes every column the same width regardless of
    // content, so the three months in expanded mode share width evenly and
    // cells shrink uniformly when the viewport is tight.
    table.style.tableLayout = 'fixed';

    // Day-name header
    const thead = document.createElement('thead');
    const headerRow = document.createElement('tr');
    const dayNames = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    dayNames.forEach(day => {
        const th = document.createElement('th');
        th.className = compact
            ? 'px-0.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 bg-slate-100'
            : 'px-2 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 bg-slate-100';
        th.style.width = `${100 / 7}%`;
        th.textContent = day;
        headerRow.appendChild(th);
    });
    thead.appendChild(headerRow);
    table.appendChild(thead);

    // Body — week rows. Row heights start at a baseline; renderCalendarWOs
    // resizes them after tiles render so overflows can't happen.
    const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
    let currentDay = calendarStart.clone();
    const initialRowHeight = compact ? 64 : 80;
    const insetPad = compact ? 'p-0.5' : 'p-1';
    const fontDay  = compact ? 'text-[10px]' : 'text-xs';
    const fontMeta = compact ? 'text-[9px]'  : 'text-xs';

    for (let week = 0; week < numWeeks; week++) {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');

        for (let day = 0; day < 7; day++) {
            const cell = document.createElement('td');
            cell.className = 'border border-slate-300 p-0 align-top relative cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors';
            cell.style.height = `${initialRowHeight}px`;

            const isCurrentMonth = currentDay.month() === monthStart.month();
            const isToday        = currentDay.isSame(moment(), 'day');
            const isWeekend      = day >= 5;

            // Capacity status drives a subtle cell background tint + the "!"
            // glyph for over-cap days. The previous bottom stripe + 2px red
            // border were visually noisy when stacked next to the cell's own
            // 1px border, especially in the 3-month strip. A faint background
            // wash reads cleanly at any cell size.
            const capStatus = _dayCapacityStatus(currentDay);
            let capBg = '';
            if      (capStatus.status === 'over') capBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.10)';   // red wash
            else if (capStatus.status === 'warn') capBg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.10)';  // amber wash
            // 'ok' and 'none' get no tint — keeps the calendar visually quiet.

            const usageStr = `${capStatus.totalUsage.toFixed(0)}/${capStatus.totalCapacity}h`;
            const showUsage = !compact;  // compact cells drop the usage label

            // Base background — weekend amber wins, then capacity tint, then white.
            let cellBg;
            if (isWeekend)      cellBg = capBg || '#fffbeb';   // amber-50 fallback
            else                cellBg = capBg || '#ffffff';

            cell.innerHTML = `
                <div class="${insetPad} ${isCurrentMonth ? '' : 'opacity-40'} h-full" style="position:relative;background:${cellBg};">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-1">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                            <span class="${fontDay} font-semibold ${isToday ? 'bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5' : 'text-slate-600'}">${currentDay.format('D')}</span>
                            ${showUsage ? `<span class="${fontMeta} text-slate-500 truncate">${usageStr}</span>` : ''}
                        </div>
                        ${capStatus.status === 'over' ? `<span class="${fontMeta} text-red-600 font-bold leading-none">!</span>` : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            // Cell tooltip lists the per-category breakdown. Native title only —
            // fine for power-user diagnostic info.
            if (capStatus.breakdown.length > 0) {
                cell.title = `${currentDay.format('ddd MMM D')}\n` +
                    capStatus.breakdown
                        .map(b => `${b.name}: ${b.usage.toFixed(1)}h / ${b.cap}h (${b.pct.toFixed(0)}%)${b.pct >= 100 ? '  ⚠' : ''}`)
                        .join('\n');
            }

            // Click → scroll weekly view to that week
            const clickDay = currentDay.clone();
            cell.addEventListener('click', () => {
                scrollCapacityToWeek(clickDay.clone().startOf('isoWeek'));
            });

            // Drop zone for drawer / calendar WO drags
            cell.setAttribute('data-calendar-date', clickDay.format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
            cell.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
                cell.style.backgroundColor = '#e0e7ff';
            });
            cell.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
                cell.style.backgroundColor = '';
            });
            cell.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                cell.style.backgroundColor = '';
                try {
                    const dragData = JSON.parse(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
                    handleCalendarWODrop(dragData, clickDay.format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
                } catch (err) {
                    debugLog('error', 'Error handling calendar WO drop:', err);
                }
            });

            // Over-cap days are flagged by the red wash + "!" glyph inside the
            // cell — no separate border treatment needed.

            row.appendChild(cell);
            currentDay.add(1, 'day');
        }
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    }
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    return table;
}

// Compute the day-level capacity status used by both the day-cell edge
// stripe and the cell tooltip. Walks every category, picks the most
// loaded one to decide the status colour, and returns a sorted breakdown
// of categories with non-zero usage. Honours the diff-mode overlay (so
// projected usage drives the colour in 'new' / 'both' modes).
function _dayCapacityStatus(dayMoment) {
    let totalUsage = 0, totalCapacity = 0, maxPct = 0;
    const breakdown = [];
    for (const cat of capacitySettings.categories) {
        const dow = dayMoment.isoWeekday() - 1;
        const cap = cat.limits[dow];
        if (cap <= 0) continue;
        const usage = _usageForCategoryAndDayProjected(cat.id, dayMoment);
        totalUsage    += usage;
        totalCapacity += cap;
        const pct = (usage / cap) * 100;
        if (pct > maxPct) maxPct = pct;
        if (usage > 0.01) breakdown.push({ name: cat.name, usage, cap, pct });
    }
    breakdown.sort((a, b) => b.pct - a.pct);
    let status;
    if      (maxPct >= 100) status = 'over';
    else if (maxPct >= 80)  status = 'warn';
    else if (totalUsage > 0) status = 'ok';
    else status = 'none';
    return { status, totalUsage, totalCapacity, maxPct, breakdown };
}

// Render the capacity heatmap. Only meaningful when the calendar is
// expanded; called from buildMonthCalendar in that mode. Categories
// occupy rows, days the visible 3-month window occupy columns. Cells
// are coloured by per-category utilisation (honouring diff mode).
function renderCapacityHeatmap() {
    const host = document.getElementById('capacityHeatmap');
    if (!host) {
        debugLog('warn', 'renderCapacityHeatmap: #capacityHeatmap host missing');
        return;
    }
    if (!_calendarExpanded) { host.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    debugLog('info', `renderCapacityHeatmap: rendering, categories=${capacitySettings.categories.length}, WOs=${filteredWorkOrders.length}`);

    const rangeStart = currentCalendarMonth.clone().subtract(1, 'month').startOf('month');
    const rangeEnd   = currentCalendarMonth.clone().add(1, 'month').endOf('month');
    const totalDays  = rangeEnd.diff(rangeStart, 'days') + 1;

    const rangeDisplay = document.getElementById('heatmapRangeDisplay');
    if (rangeDisplay) {
        rangeDisplay.textContent = `${rangeStart.format('MMM D')} – ${rangeEnd.format('MMM D, YYYY')}`;
    }

    // Categories: by default, only those with WOs in the visible window
    // (toggle to show all). Sort alpha. The pendingMap overlay matters for
    // "has WOs in window" so reshuffled WOs that moved into the window
    // count, and ones that moved out do not.
    const showEmpty = document.getElementById('heatmapShowEmpty')?.checked || false;
    let cats = [...capacitySettings.categories].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    if (!showEmpty) {
        const usedCatIds = new Set();
        for (const wo of filteredWorkOrders) {
            const ch = _pendingScheduleChanges && _pendingScheduleChanges[wo.wo_id];
            const s = ch ? moment(ch.newStart) : moment(wo.date_scheduled_start);
            const e = ch ? moment(ch.newEnd)   : moment(wo.date_scheduled);
            if (s.isValid() && e.isValid() && s.isBefore(rangeEnd) && e.isAfter(rangeStart)) {
                usedCatIds.add(wo.calcategory_id);
            }
        }
        cats = cats.filter(c => usedCatIds.has(c.id));
    }
    debugLog('info', `renderCapacityHeatmap: ${cats.length} categor${cats.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'} after filter (showEmpty=${showEmpty})`);
    if (cats.length === 0) {
        host.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-sm text-slate-400 italic p-8">No categories with WOs in this range. Toggle "Show empty categories" to see all.</div>';
        return;
    }

    // Build the table. `table-layout: fixed` + width:100% lets the cells
    // share whatever width the host card has — at 1080p the heatmap fills
    // the visible area instead of overflowing into a horizontal scrollbar.
    // Each day cell ends up around 12–18px wide depending on viewport,
    // which is still readable as a colour grid.
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.style.borderCollapse = 'collapse';
    table.style.tableLayout = 'fixed';
    table.style.width = '100%';
    table.style.fontFamily = "'Inter', sans-serif";

    // Header. The day columns share `(100% - 120px) / totalDays` evenly via
    // table-layout:fixed; per-cell `width` is set so the layout engine has a
    // consistent target.
    // v4: header strip uses PO-summary dark navy. White day-numbers on
    // navy is significantly higher contrast than the previous slate-400
    // on white, and lets us drop the per-cell month-start dividers.
    const dayColPct = (100 - 12) / totalDays;  // leave ~12% for the sticky category column
    const thead = document.createElement('thead');
    const hRow  = document.createElement('tr');
    const catHeader = document.createElement('th');
    catHeader.style.cssText = 'width:120px;padding:7px 10px;text-align:left;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-weight:500;background:var(--header-dark);position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2;';
    catHeader.textContent = 'Category';
    hRow.appendChild(catHeader);

    for (let i = 0; i < totalDays; i++) {
        const day = rangeStart.clone().add(i, 'days');
        const isMonthStart = day.date() === 1 && i > 0;
        const isWeekStart  = day.day() === 1; // Monday
        const isWeekend    = day.day() === 0 || day.day() === 6;
        const th = document.createElement('th');
        // Navy header. Weekend cells get a slightly lighter navy wash so the
        // weekend rhythm is still visible. Month boundaries get a 2px white
        // divider instead of grey.
        const cellBg = isWeekend ? '#2a4a73' : 'var(--header-dark)';
        th.style.cssText = `width:${dayColPct}%;padding:3px 0;font-size:10px;text-align:center;color:white;font-weight:500;background:${cellBg};${isMonthStart ? 'border-left:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);' : ''}`;
        // Show date number on Mondays and month starts; otherwise blank.
        th.textContent = (isWeekStart || isMonthStart) ? day.format('D') : '';
        th.title = day.format('ddd, MMM D YYYY');
        hRow.appendChild(th);
    }
    thead.appendChild(hRow);
    table.appendChild(thead);

    // Body — one row per category
    const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
    cats.forEach(cat => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        const catCell = document.createElement('td');
        catCell.style.cssText = 'padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#334155;border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0;position:sticky;left:0;background:white;z-index:1;';
        const dot = document.createElement('span');
        dot.style.cssText = `display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:${cat.color};margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle;`;
        catCell.appendChild(dot);
        const nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
        const dispName = cat.name.length > 18 ? cat.name.substring(0, 17) + '…' : cat.name;
        nameSpan.textContent = dispName;
        nameSpan.title = cat.name;
        catCell.appendChild(nameSpan);
        row.appendChild(catCell);

        for (let i = 0; i < totalDays; i++) {
            const day = rangeStart.clone().add(i, 'days');
            const dow = day.isoWeekday() - 1;
            const cap = cat.limits[dow];
            const usage = _usageForCategoryAndDayProjected(cat.id, day);
            const pct = cap > 0 ? usage / cap : 0;
            const isMonthStart = day.date() === 1 && i > 0;
            const isWeekStart  = day.day() === 1;
            const isWeekend    = day.day() === 0 || day.day() === 6;

            let bgColor, textColor = '#1e293b';
            if (cap <= 0) {
                bgColor = '#f1f5f9';  // closed day
            } else if (pct >= 1)   { bgColor = '#dc2626'; textColor = 'white'; }
            else if (pct >= 0.9)   { bgColor = '#ea580c'; textColor = 'white'; }
            else if (pct >= 0.6)   { bgColor = '#f59e0b'; }
            else if (pct > 0)      { bgColor = '#10b981'; textColor = 'white'; }
            else                    { bgColor = isWeekend ? '#fef3c7' : '#f8fafc'; }

            const cell = document.createElement('td');
            cell.style.cssText = `background:${bgColor};color:${textColor};height:22px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0;overflow:hidden;${isWeekStart ? 'border-left:1px solid #cbd5e1;' : ''}${isMonthStart ? 'border-left:2px solid #94a3b8;' : ''}`;
            cell.title = `${day.format('ddd MMM D')} · ${cat.name}\n${usage.toFixed(2)}h / ${cap}h (${(pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%)${pct >= 1 ? '  ⚠ over' : ''}`;

            // Click — scroll the weekly capacity view to this week (still
            // accessible after the user collapses back to compact mode).
            const clickDay = day.clone();
            cell.style.cursor = 'pointer';
            cell.addEventListener('click', () => scrollCapacityToWeek(clickDay.clone().startOf('isoWeek')));

            row.appendChild(cell);
        }
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
    table.appendChild(tbody);

    host.innerHTML = '';
    host.appendChild(table);
}

function renderCalendarWOs(table, calendarStart) {
    const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
    const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
    const totalDays = rows.length * 7;
    const calendarEnd = calendarStart.clone().add(totalDays, 'days');

    // Phase 3: build tile renders. Each WO becomes 1 or 2 renders depending
    // on whether it has a pending schedule change and the current diff mode.
    //   variant 'normal'  — saved schedule, normal styling
    //   variant 'dimmed'  — original position of a WO with a pending change
    //                       (only shown in 'both' mode; non-interactive)
    //   variant 'pending' — new position of a WO with a pending change
    //                       (dashed border, special tooltip; not draggable
    //                       until the change is committed or discarded)
    const pendingMap = _pendingScheduleChanges || {};
    const hasPending = Object.keys(pendingMap).length > 0;
    const diffMode = _scheduleDiffMode;

    const tileRenders = [];
    filteredWorkOrders.forEach(wo => {
        if (!showCompletedWOs && wo.wo_status === 40) return;
        const change = pendingMap[wo.wo_id];

        const variants = [];
        if (change && hasPending) {
            if (diffMode === 'current') {
                if (wo.date_scheduled_start && wo.date_scheduled)
                    variants.push({ start: wo.date_scheduled_start, end: wo.date_scheduled, variant: 'normal', change });
            } else if (diffMode === 'new') {
                variants.push({ start: change.newStart, end: change.newEnd, variant: 'pending', change });
            } else { // both
                if (wo.date_scheduled_start && wo.date_scheduled)
                    variants.push({ start: wo.date_scheduled_start, end: wo.date_scheduled, variant: 'dimmed', change });
                variants.push({ start: change.newStart, end: change.newEnd, variant: 'pending', change });
            }
        } else {
            if (wo.date_scheduled_start && wo.date_scheduled)
                variants.push({ start: wo.date_scheduled_start, end: wo.date_scheduled, variant: 'normal', change: null });
        }

        for (const v of variants) {
            if (!v.start || !v.end) continue;
            const woStart = moment(v.start).startOf('day');
            let woEnd = moment(v.end).endOf('day');
            // date_finished cap only applies to current/saved positions
            if (v.variant !== 'pending' && wo.wo_status === 40 && wo.date_finished) {
                const df = moment(wo.date_finished).endOf('day');
                woEnd = moment.min(woEnd, df);
            }
            if (woStart.isBefore(calendarEnd) && woEnd.isAfter(calendarStart)) {
                tileRenders.push({ wo, woStart, woEnd, variant: v.variant, change: v.change });
            }
        }
    });

    // Pack tile renders into lanes via a synthetic pool so dimmed + pending
    // tiles for the same WO each get their own lane slot when they overlap.
    const packPool = tileRenders.map(tr => ({
        date_scheduled_start: tr.woStart.toISOString(),
        date_scheduled:       tr.woEnd.toISOString(),
    }));
    packWOsIntoLanes(packPool);
    for (let i = 0; i < packPool.length; i++) tileRenders[i]._lane = packPool[i]._lane;

    // Render each tile
    tileRenders.forEach(tr => {
        const wo = tr.wo;
        const woStart = tr.woStart;
        const woEnd = tr.woEnd;

        const startDayIndex = Math.max(0, woStart.diff(calendarStart, 'days'));
        const endDayIndex = Math.min(totalDays - 1, woEnd.diff(calendarStart, 'days'));
        if (startDayIndex >= totalDays || endDayIndex < 0) return;

        const startRow = Math.floor(startDayIndex / 7);
        const startCol = startDayIndex % 7;
        const endRow = Math.floor(endDayIndex / 7);
        const endCol = endDayIndex % 7;
        if (startRow !== endRow) return; // single-row WOs only

        const row = rows[startRow];
        if (!row) return;

        const woBar = document.createElement('div');
        const isDimmed  = tr.variant === 'dimmed';
        const isPending = tr.variant === 'pending';
        // v4: tiles are thin colour strips. The day cell can pack many WOs
        // without text overlap; identifying info lives in the tooltip.
        // Pending tiles are not draggable — user must commit/discard first.
        // Dimmed tiles are non-interactive ghosts of the original position.
        woBar.className = 'absolute rounded transition-opacity border'
                       + (isDimmed ? '' : ' cursor-move hover:opacity-80');
        woBar.draggable = !isDimmed && !isPending;
        woBar.setAttribute('data-wo-id', wo.wo_id);
        woBar.setAttribute('data-wo-num', wo.wo_num);
        woBar.setAttribute('data-wo-variant', tr.variant);
        if (!isDimmed && !isPending) {
            woBar.setAttribute('data-wo-start', wo.date_scheduled_start);
            woBar.setAttribute('data-wo-end',   wo.date_scheduled);
        }

        const rowWidth = row.offsetWidth;
        const cellWidth = rowWidth / 7;
        const horizontalPadding = 4;
        const left  = (startCol * cellWidth) + horizontalPadding;
        const width = ((endCol - startCol + 1) * cellWidth) - (horizontalPadding * 2);
        // Thin strips (8px) with 4px lane gap — packs ~5 lanes into the
        // vertical room one tall tile used to occupy.
        const TILE_H = 8;
        const LANE_PITCH = 12;
        const top   = 22 + ((tr._lane || 0) * LANE_PITCH);
        woBar.style.left = `${left}px`;
        woBar.style.top = `${top}px`;
        woBar.style.width = `${width}px`;
        woBar.style.height = `${TILE_H}px`;
        woBar.style.zIndex = isDimmed ? '8' : '10';

        // Labour/elapsed split (unchanged)
        const totalHours   = parseFloat(wo.labourHours)  || 0;
        const elapsedHours = parseFloat(wo.elapsedHours) || totalHours;
        const labourFraction = elapsedHours > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, totalHours / elapsedHours)) : 1;
        const showSplit = labourFraction < 0.999 && labourFraction > 0;
        const splitPct  = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, labourFraction * 100));

        if (calendarColorMode === 'category' && wo.category_color) {
            const categoryColor = wo.category_color.startsWith('#') ? wo.category_color : '#' + wo.category_color;
            if (showSplit) {
                woBar.style.background = `linear-gradient(to right, ` +
                    `${categoryColor} 0%, ${categoryColor} ${splitPct}%, ` +
                    `${categoryColor}40 ${splitPct}%, ${categoryColor}40 100%)`;
            } else {
                woBar.style.backgroundColor = categoryColor + '40';
            }
            woBar.style.borderColor = categoryColor;
            woBar.style.color = '#06162d';
        } else {
            const colors = WO_STATUS_COLORS[wo.wo_status] || WO_STATUS_COLORS[10];
            woBar.className += ` ${colors.border} ${colors.text}`;
            if (showSplit) {
                const fillHex = colors.fill;
                woBar.style.background = `linear-gradient(to right, ` +
                    `${fillHex} 0%, ${fillHex} ${splitPct}%, ` +
                    `${fillHex}66 ${splitPct}%, ${fillHex}66 100%)`;
            } else {
                woBar.className += ` ${colors.bg}`;
            }
        }

        // Variant-specific overrides
        if (isDimmed) {
            woBar.style.opacity = '0.32';
            woBar.style.filter = 'grayscale(0.5)';
            woBar.style.cursor = 'default';
            woBar.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        } else if (isPending) {
            woBar.style.borderStyle = 'dashed';
            woBar.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 1px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4)';
            woBar.style.cursor = 'help';
        }

        // No textContent — tiles are thin colour strips; identifying info
        // lives in the tooltip below.

        const labourDelta = Math.max(0, elapsedHours - totalHours);
        const statusName = wo.wo_status === 10 ? 'Entered' : wo.wo_status === 30 ? 'Started' : wo.wo_status === 40 ? 'Fulfilled' : 'Unknown';
        let calendarTooltipHTML  = '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">WO:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + wo.wo_num + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">MO:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + wo.mo_num + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Category:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + (wo.category_name || 'Uncategorized') + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">BOM:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + (wo.bom_num || 'N/A') + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Finished Good:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + (wo.part_num || 'N/A') + ' x ' + (wo.qty_target || '?') + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Status:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + statusName + '</span></div>';
        calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Labour:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + totalHours.toFixed(2) + 'h' + (labourDelta > 0 ? ' + ' + labourDelta.toFixed(2) + 'h non-labour' : '') + '</span></div>';
        if (tr.change && (isPending || isDimmed)) {
            const oldS = tr.change.originalStart ? formatDate(moment(tr.change.originalStart)) : '—';
            const oldE = tr.change.originalEnd   ? formatDate(moment(tr.change.originalEnd))   : '—';
            const newS = formatDate(moment(tr.change.newStart));
            const newE = formatDate(moment(tr.change.newEnd));
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div style="margin-top:6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #334155;">';
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Was:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + oldS + ' → ' + oldE + '</span></div>';
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">New:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value" style="color:#86efac;">' + newS + ' → ' + newE + '</span></div>';
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div style="font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:3px;font-style:italic;">Pending — Save All to commit</div>';
            calendarTooltipHTML += '</div>';
        } else {
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Start:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + formatDate(woStart) + '</span></div>';
            calendarTooltipHTML += '<div><span class="wo-tooltip-label">Finish:</span><span class="wo-tooltip-value">' + formatDate(woEnd) + '</span></div>';
        }

        if (!isDimmed) {
            woBar.addEventListener('mouseover', e => showWOTooltip(e, calendarTooltipHTML));
            woBar.addEventListener('mouseout',  () => hideWOTooltip());
            woBar.addEventListener('mousemove', e => showWOTooltip(e, calendarTooltipHTML));
        }

        // Drag + click + right-click — only on plain (non-pending, non-dimmed) tiles.
        // Pending tiles are read-only previews until the user commits or discards.
        if (!isDimmed && !isPending) {
            woBar.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
                e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', JSON.stringify({
                    wo_id: wo.wo_id,
                    wo_num: wo.wo_num,
                    originalStart: wo.date_scheduled_start,
                    originalEnd: wo.date_scheduled
                }));
                woBar.style.opacity = '0.5';
            });
            woBar.addEventListener('dragend', () => { woBar.style.opacity = '1'; });
            woBar.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const weekStart = woStart.clone().startOf('isoWeek');
                scrollCapacityToWeek(weekStart);
            });
            woBar.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                hideWOTooltip();
                showWOContextMenu(e, wo);
            });
        }

        row.style.position = 'relative';
        row.appendChild(woBar);
    });

    // Post-render row-height fit. The lane heights computed in
    // buildMonthCalendar are based on saved WO positions only, so any extra
    // vertical space introduced here (e.g. dimmed + pending pairs in 'both'
    // diff mode, or many overlapping WOs in one week) would overflow into
    // the next row. This pass walks each rendered row, finds the tallest
    // tile's bottom edge, and resizes the row + every <td> so all tiles
    // fit. Baseline 30px reserves room for the day number + edge stripe.
    rows.forEach(row => {
        const tiles = row.querySelectorAll('div[data-wo-id]');
        if (!tiles.length) return;
        let maxBottom = 30;
        tiles.forEach(t => {
            const top = parseInt(t.style.top, 10) || 0;
            const h   = parseInt(t.style.height, 10) || 20;
            if (top + h > maxBottom) maxBottom = top + h;
        });
        const newHeight = maxBottom + 8;
        row.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
        row.querySelectorAll('td').forEach(td => td.style.height = newHeight + 'px');
    });
}

// ============================================
// INITIALIZATION
// ============================================
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Initialize date ranges now that moment.js is loaded
    if (typeof moment === 'undefined') {
        const debugLogEl = document.getElementById('debugLog');
        if (debugLogEl) {
            debugLogEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-red-400">[ERROR] moment.js not loaded! Check internet connection or CDN access.</div>';
        }
        console.error('moment.js is not loaded!');
        return;
    }

    ganttStartDate = moment().startOf('isoWeek');
    ganttEndDate = moment().startOf('isoWeek').add(14, 'days');

    // Show debug console if DEBUG_MODE is enabled
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        const debugConsoleContainer = document.getElementById('debugConsoleContainer');
        if (debugConsoleContainer) {
            debugConsoleContainer.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }

    debugLog('info', 'Application starting...');
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        debugLog('info', 'Debug mode enabled via BI_SHOW_DEBUG property');
    }

    // Initialize event listeners for UI controls
    initializeEventListeners();

    // Load work orders (settings will be loaded after categories are initialized)
    loadWorkOrders();
});
</script>
